description.p: My Notes is a native GTK and Libadwaita Markdown editor for GNOME. Keep your notes as local files and browse them in a folder sidebar.

ul.li: Edit Markdown with a live preview or use separate editor and preview views.
Use CommonMark or enable GitHub Flavoured Markdown extensions.
Preview tables, task lists, links and images.
Find and replace text, undo edits and return to recent notes.
Create notes in your chosen folder with protection against accidental overwrites.

screenshot.caption: Browse notes and edit Markdown alongside its live preview
Read formatted notes in the preview-only view

description.p: The first release of My Notes brings Markdown editing and a native live preview to GNOME.

ul.li: Browse folders, create notes and return to the five most recent files.
Choose editor-only, split or preview-only views.
Use CommonMark or enable tables, task lists and other GitHub Flavoured Markdown extensions.
Find and replace text, undo and redo edits, and choose text or icon toolbar buttons.
